description: This file defines a reusable UI component 'SearchBar' for a Qwik-based frontend. The component manages URL query parameters for search functionality, providing an input box, clear button, and submit handling with URL navigation.

methods.name: SearchBar
methods.description: A Qwik component that manages a search input tied to the URL query parameter 'q'. It initializes its state from the URL, updates the URL on submission, and allows clearing the search input.
